title: nb: conclusions/leads never get proposed; results pile up unconcluded

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text:
## Evidence (bioemu-kinetics, 2026-11-09)
- 7 conclusions, all 2026-10-30 to 11-02, each written after the user explicitly asked ("write up some conclusions", "draw that conclusion"). 0 leads ever.
- Since 11-03: 31 results, 0 conclusions. 13 of 51 results back any conclusion.
- All 33 hypotheses are open, though 10 results state the frozen-rule verdict in the summary ("Frozen rule: refuted ...").
- 30 of 31 frozen experiments/explorations have results but none was set to done, so the prime "In flight" section is mostly finished work.
- Transcripts: after a result the agent gives a labelled "My read" in chat (~12+), offered to record a conclusion 0 times, declined once ("Not recorded ... stays mine until you want it recorded"), and steered to the next experiment ~6-8 times. The user always replied with the next action.
- Cause: SKILL.md "Record no conclusions or leads ... unless the user asks" and "Interpreting (only when asked)". Pending + the gated confirm already gives the user the veto, so this second guard is redundant. No prime section or lint rule surfaces unconcluded results.
- Side: prime runs lint without the provenance checks, so it reported 1 warning while nb lint reports 12 (missing docs/figures artifacts).

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: User proposal (2026-11-09): block new experiments while earlier ones have no conclusion, except experiments running in parallel. Proposed shape, still open: gate nb freeze rather than nb add; an experiment that has results blocks new freezes until it is closed (done with a conclusion, or done with --no-conclusion and a reason); an experiment with no results yet counts as running in parallel. Undecided: whether explorations are gated too; whether a pending conclusion unblocks or a confirmed one is required; how to handle the backlog (16 experiments and 14 explorations are frozen with results); whether parallel is implicit or a flag.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Decided with user 2026-11-09: the gate blocks nb freeze, not nb add. Explorations are gated too and close with a lead or a reason. Only a CONFIRMED conclusion or lead unblocks; a pending one does not. Parallel means the experiment has no results yet (implicit, no flag). Still open: how to handle the backlog. Also found: conclusion titles run 261-655 chars and nothing caps them. Confirming a conclusion never moves the status of the hypothesis it supports or the question it answers: all 6 hypotheses and 3 questions with a supported conclusion are still open.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Decided with user 2026-11-09: no length cap on claim titles; instead one claim per conclusion. nb confirm will offer to update the linked hypothesis and question statuses. New complaint: in chat the agent refers to nodes by bare ids (exp-pb59) when asking the user for decisions, and the ids tell the user nothing. The gate prompt already shows type, id and title (gate.py:33), so the problem is chat text plus nb add printing only the id (nb:818).

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Decided with user 2026-11-09: backlog option (a): once the design is settled, an agent drafts one-claim conclusions and leads for the frozen-with-results items and the user triages them. Ids: (1) a skill rule to give the name first, then the id, and never ask a question about a bare id; (2) nb add, result and freeze print the id with its title. No aliases for now. Note: the phase 3 PostToolUse injection text in SPEC (record no conclusions or leads) contradicts this direction and must change.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: User direction 2026-11-09: the frozen rule decides a hypothesis directly, with no conclusion node. The verdict (supported / refuted / inconclusive) goes with the result; the experiment closes once all its predictions have verdicts. Conclusions are then for interpretation only, and the user gives their read first. Checked in bioemu: each of the 33 hypotheses is tested by exactly one experiment, and the rules are three-way numeric bands. Open: whether applying a verdict needs approval. Risk: with experiments closing on verdicts, the gate no longer forces any interpretation, so cross-run findings could still go unrecorded; proposed a prime section listing questions whose hypotheses all have verdicts but no conclusion.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Decided 2026-11-09: verdicts apply automatically, and a wrong one is corrected with a gated nb status. The user still wants conclusions drawn. Proposed: a gate on each question. Once K experiments on a question (default 3) have closed since its last confirmed conclusion, nb freeze refuses another experiment on that question until either a confirmed conclusion answers it, or the user logs "no conclusion yet: <reason>", which resets the count. The agent shows the facts for those runs and asks the user for their read first, then drafts one-claim conclusions from what the user said. In bioemu, q-35qb (runs 13-19) has 7 experiments and 0 conclusions; q-d7mx (BBL, protein G, BBA) has 3 and 0; q-6j0r has 4 and 0.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Revised 2026-11-09: no fixed K, because a question can be answered at the 1st experiment or the 20th. Proposed instead: a check-in on the question when freezing. Before freezing a new experiment or exploration on question Q, Q must have a check-in since its last closed experiment: either a confirmed conclusion or lead, or a "not yet" (cheap, logged on the question). At the check-in the agent shows a brief that nb generates mechanically (proposed nb brief <q>: hypotheses with their verdicts and key numbers, results, conclusions, leads, by name), then asks for the user's read. The agent drafts one-claim conclusions from what the user said and stores the user's words verbatim in the body. The auditor checks the draft against the evidence AND against the user's words.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Revised 2026-11-09: the check-in happens right after each result, not at freeze. The agent shows nb brief for that result (related results and the conclusions and leads they touch) and asks for the user's read. The answer is a conclusion or lead drafted from the user's words, or "nothing yet". The freeze gate blocks only while a result has not been reviewed. Conclusions do not need an answers link: drop --link answers from the skill example. Connectivity gap found: bioemu has 0 variant-of links (run lineage lives only in titles). The two-state explorations investigate q-3adm, separate from the run questions. xpl-zjfp (run 19 two-state) uses res-zpc6 and res-k8h7 but not run 19's own result res-0kbx. So the brief must follow uses in both directions, variant-of and shared hypothesis/question, plus a labelled "possibly related, unlinked" section found by tags and text.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Decided 2026-11-09: nb brief is deterministic and involves no agent judgment. It is tiered: the new result and its verdict first, then directly linked items (same hypothesis, variant-of chain, uses), then the same question, then "possibly related, not linked". One line per item: name, verdict, key number. Each tier has a cap that ends in "(+N more: <command>)"; nothing is dropped silently, and caps live in config. The agent shows the brief as is: it may not drop lines or add its own read unless asked.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: SPEC draft written 2026-11-09 (uncommitted, on nb-dev): plugins/lab-notebook/SPEC.md, new section "Closing the loop". Skill draft at plugins/lab-notebook/drafts/SKILL.md; the live SKILL.md is untouched because sessions may load it from the working tree. Awaiting user review before any code.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: SPEC reviewed by a fresh agent and revised 2026-11-09; committed as 16cdada. Fixes: durable reviews field (written at confirm, at user add and by nothing-yet); verdicts made an append-only history, added to the post-freeze mutable list and to sync; derived hypothesis status by most recent event; reruns of a done experiment become a new variant-of experiment; exploration done stays manual; interim-only work warns; audit freshness rule; latest audit counts; atomic --verdict; migration note. Implementation delegated to a worktree agent; not merged into nb-dev yet.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Implemented on branch worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce (3873614, 61c63d4, 1bd7c7e): 166 tests pass, plugin validate passes. Not merged. Dry run on a copy of the bioemu notebook: 0 errors, 38 warnings, and with the gate on 65 items would block. Problems found on real data: (1) brief lines use result titles, which in bioemu are summary text ("Frozen rule: supported: ..."), so lines do not say which run; (2) the possibly-related tier matches only result titles and treats common words (villin, core, endpoints) as equal to "run 19", so run 19's own two-state result res-8fe6 is missing from res-0kbx's brief even with --all. Proposed fix: also match on the experiment/exploration title, weight tokens by rarity, show the experiment name on each line. Also: same-date event order falls back to experiment id; proposed recording a timestamp on verdict and confirm-also events instead.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Decided 2026-11-09: no text matching in the brief. It follows links only, and lineage is fixed upstream instead. uses may target an experiment or exploration (its outputs); freeze requires variant-of, uses or an explicit fresh, and the freeze prompt shows them by name; brief lines show the experiment name; the auditor searches for unlinked evidence and reports it as a missing link; verdict and confirm-also events carry a UTC time (at). SPEC commit 8bcd882 on the worktree branch; implementer resumed.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Link-only follow-up implemented on the worktree branch (5335069, 9d60a12): 175 tests pass, validate passes. On the bioemu copy, after nb link xpl-zjfp uses exp-9qe0, the brief for res-0kbx lists res-8fe6 under Directly linked. Branch is 6 commits ahead of nb-dev (16cdada..9d60a12). Not merged; merging puts the new skill live in bioemu sessions.
